question: The women’s team from ____________lifted the 9th National Women’s Ice Hockey Championship in Himachal Pradesh in January 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Women's Ice Hockey Championship is organized every year by the **Ice Hockey Association Of India.**
 
• The event was organized at** Kaza** in **Himachal Pradesh**.
 
• The event was held for the duration of 5 days from **15/01/2022 - 20/01/2022.**
 
• Six teams participated in the event in **Delhi, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, Telangana, and ITBP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information __​**

 
• Ladakh is a** Union Territory** and comes under the **administration of the Home Ministry.**
 
• The capital of Ladakh is **Leh and Kargil.**
 
• Ladakh is** one of the most sparsely populated regions** of India. Its culture and history are closely related to Tibet.
 
• The majority population in Ladakh is **Muslim.**
